service: DOLE Assistance for Request Management System / SEnA
when_to_use: Private-sector labor requests for assistance and excluded labor categories accepted by SEnA.
first_step: File or track a Request for Assistance through DOLE ARMS, or call DOLE Hotline 1349.

service: Consumer Complaints Assistance and Resolution System
when_to_use: Ordinary consumer-product, service, and online-transaction complaints within DTI jurisdiction.
first_step: Use the DTI CARe portal or contact ConsumerCare before escalation.
office_address: DTI Fair Trade Enforcement Bureau, 361 Sen. Gil J. Puyat Ave., Makati City

service: Legal counselling and assistance for qualified clients
when_to_use: A question needs individualized legal advice, representation, case strategy, or another remedy outside the information system.
first_step: Review PAO qualification and regional contact information, then contact the appropriate PAO office.
office_address: DOJ Agencies Building, NIA Road corner East Avenue, Diliman, Quezon City

when_to_use: Overseas Filipino worker employment, recruitment, welfare, or repatriation concerns.
first_step: Contact the DMW hotline or the appropriate Migrant Workers Office.
office_address: Blas F. Ople Building, Ortigas Avenue corner EDSA, Mandaluyong City

when_to_use: Seafarer certification, training, STCW, and maritime professional concerns.
first_step: Contact the MARINA STCW Administration Office; overseas employment concerns may also require DMW.
office_address: MARINA Building, Bonifacio Drive corner 20th Street, Port Area, Manila

when_to_use: Government employment and public-service concerns outside private-sector labor scope.
first_step: Use Contact Center ng Bayan or contact the appropriate CSC regional office.

when_to_use: Employees' compensation, occupational disease, work-injury benefit, disability, and appeal concerns.
first_step: Contact the ECC Public Assistance Center or the appropriate regional extension unit.
office_address: ECC Building, 355 Sen. Gil J. Puyat Ave., Makati City

when_to_use: Technical workplace-safety, health, training, or exposure concerns outside the MVP.
first_step: Contact OSHC or the relevant regional extension unit.
office_address: North Avenue corner Sen. Miriam P. Defensor-Santiago Avenue, Diliman, Quezon City

when_to_use: Private-sector social-security contribution, retirement, pension, and benefit questions.
first_step: Use My.SSS or contact the SSS hotline for member-specific records and computations.
office_address: SSS Main Building, East Avenue, Diliman, Quezon City

when_to_use: Exact current regional wage rates and wage-order coverage.
first_step: Check the current wage order and regional wage-board information on the NWPC website.

when_to_use: Unresolved complaints involving BSP-supervised banks, e-money issuers, payment systems, and other supervised institutions.
first_step: Complain first to the financial institution, then escalate through BSP Online Buddy or the BSP consumer-assistance channel.
office_address: BSP Complex, A. Mabini Street, Malate, Manila

when_to_use: Investment scams and complaints involving registered or unauthorized lending and financing companies.
first_step: Use SEC iMessage; the applicable SEC department depends on whether the concern involves lending, financing, or investments.

when_to_use: Insurance, pre-need, HMO, mutual-benefit, and insurance-broker complaints.
first_step: Contact the Insurance Commission Public Assistance and Mediation Division.

when_to_use: Misuse, disclosure, breach, or improper processing of personal information.
first_step: Review the NPC complaint requirements and use the current complaint-assisted form.
office_address: 25th-27th Floors, The Upper Class Tower, Quezon Ave. corner Scout Reyes St., Quezon City

when_to_use: Telecommunications billing, poor service, spam, SIM, and related subscriber complaints.
first_step: Submit a written complaint to the NTC or the appropriate regional office.
office_address: Sen. Miriam P. Defensor-Santiago Ave., East Triangle, Diliman, Quezon City

when_to_use: Subdivision, condominium, developer, homeowner-association, and housing adjudication matters.
first_step: Determine whether the concern is adjudicatory or administrative, then consult HSAC or the proper DHSUD regional office.

agency: Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board
when_to_use: Public-transport fares, franchises, and operator-service concerns.
first_step: Use the current contact or complaint channel shown on the LTFRB official website.

when_to_use: Electricity billing, distribution-utility, and regulated-rate concerns. Other utilities may require a different regulator.
first_step: Identify the utility type and use the current complaint channel on the appropriate regulator's official website.

when_to_use: Online fraud, phishing, account takeover, and conduct requiring criminal investigation.
first_step: Preserve transaction records and use the current reporting channel on the PNP Anti-Cybercrime Group official website; urgent threats should go to local law enforcement.
